# Markham Heating & Cooling

> Markham Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Markham, York Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (905) 472-3610  |  Email: contact@markhamheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://markhamheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, Aurora, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City
